proposed_comments.title: Preserve visible keyboard focus on Home rows
proposed_comments.body:
The Home-specific `SettingsCard` style replaces the toolkit's implicit style, so it must carry over the focus settings that make keyboard focus visible. Without these setters, users can tab to a Home row without a visible focus indicator.

**Severity:** `medium`

```suggestion
                <Setter Property="UseSystemFocusVisuals" Value="True" />
                <Setter Property="FocusVisualMargin" Value="-3" />
                <Setter Property="Template">
```

confidence.rationale: The custom style replaces the toolkit style, the toolkit source supplies these two focus setters, and the literal candidate built successfully with them restored.
